headline: 3 Healthcare Stocks We Find Risky
summary: Healthcare companies are pushing the status quo by innovating in areas like drug development and digital health. Shareholders who bet on the industry have been rewarded lately as healthcare stocks have returned 16.6% over the past six months, topping the S&P 500 by 9.6 percentage points.
